title: Pointless Machine
description: Many pointless patterns for hexcasting. Balance not included.
body:
Adds some pointless hexcasting patterns that makes you ask "why are you like this".

- Enlighten: but only for armor stands.
- Metafold's Reflection: the smallest most useless quine in Hexcasting.
- Originality's Reflection: reminds you of where the origin is.
And many other awe-inspiring patterns.
